item.title: VMO2 sees broadband use hit record high
item.description: Virgin Media O2 (VMO2) saw the biggest broadband traffic spike in its history, as millions tuned in to watch the Arsenal v Atletico Madrid Champions League semi-final – a new record that highlights growing demand on the UK’s broadband networks during major live streamed sporting events.

item.title: Rahman steps down as Airband CEO
item.description: Kashif Rahman has stepped down from his role as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at Airband, with effect from 28th April 2026, the company confirmed recently.

item.title: Alncom bags community services award
item.description: Stephen Pinchen, Managing Director (MD) at Alncom said he was “beyond grateful” to receive the award, and the team had continually given community support to help many people.

item.title: FTTP reaches majority of UK premises as networks expand
item.description: New research from Point Topic has revealed updated figures on fixed broadband availability in the UK, tracking the progress to the end of Q1 2026, showing that FTTP covered 82.9% of the UK premises, compared to 80.5% at the end of Q4 2025, while Gigabit coverage was 89.3%.

item.title: Altnets must shift the quality/price paradigm, says Axon Networks Europe CEO Thomas Sørensen Boye
item.description: Competition in the UK full fibre sector has never been fiercer with newcomers looking for ways to differentiate in a saturated market.

item.title: Giganet CEO fits final piece in the puzzle
item.description: Giganet’s transition from a voice-only comms provider to a Fern Trading-backed ISP reaching over nine million premises is testament to its capacity for business transformation and commitment to building a full fibre future - and of course its ambition.

item.title: Brsk building brand advocates
item.description: Brsk aims to disrupt and gain market share in 2024, driving uptake alongside its steady build to establish itself as a ‘David’ to the ‘Goliath brands’ in the industry.

item.title: Finalists announced for 2026 UK Fibre Awards
item.description: The UK Fibre Awards 2026 shortlist of finalists has been announced, setting the stage for this year's event on June 4th at the Marriott Grosvenor Square Hotel, London (organised by BPL Business Media). Click here for the full list of finalists in each category – www.fibreawards.com/finalists.

item.title: Agility sees altnets through supply chain uncertainty
item.description: At the most severe, supply chain disruptions exposed structural weakness in fragmented procurement models and slowed down altnet activities during a critical phase of rollout.

item.title: Hurry strengthens executive team as CCO at Gigaclear
item.description: Gigaclear has appointed Jon Hurry as Chief Commercial Officer (CCO), who joins its Executive Leadership Team, as the business enters its next phase of commercial growth.

item.title: Duke to lead technology strategy as CTO at Fibeo
item.description: Fibeo has appointed Ross Duke as Chief Technology Officer (CTO), following a competitive sector-wide search, bringing with him a strong track record in scaling broadband infrastructure through high-pressure growth stages.

item.title: Netomnia hits rollout milestone in Greater Manchester
item.description: Netomnia has reached a target of delivering 30,000 premises serviceable in Cheetham Hill, marking a key milestone in expanding full fibre connectivity across this part of Greater Manchester to support residents, businesses and public services connect to a modern digital infrastructure.

item.title: ITS powers network for Woolwich Waves leisure centre
item.description: Digital Greenwich Connect - a partnership between DG Cities, the Royal Borough of Greenwich’s Innovation arm and full fibre provider ITS - has teamed up with regional operator Enlink Networks, to deliver a resilient, high-capacity digital network for the recently opened Woolwich Waves leisure centre.

item.title: Zen Internet CEO conquers HQ charity climb for WHAG
item.description: Zen Internet has raised £2,700 in support of homeless charity WHAG, after Richard Tang, CEO and founder successfully scaled the five-storey exterior of the company’s headquarters, Sandbrook House, completing a gruelling vertical challenge.

item.title: Eazycomm expands service portfolio with Bright Edge deal
item.description: Bright Edge Networks has formed a new wholesale partnership with Eazycomm to bring enhanced business connectivity services to its growing national customer base and expand its connectivity capabilities.
